usedFor: Shopify lists products, and Edusign holds courses and classrooms, so “New Product” can set one up with “Create a course”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create a course” in Edusign
bestTemplate.why: Training sold as a product gets its course in Edusign, ready for attendance sheets.

watchOut: Not every “New Product” is a course, so filter first or “Create a course” adds one for each.
